glassmorphism.header: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200/50 sticky top-0 z-50

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENTATION: Use the provided color palette variables in tailwind.config.js. Do not hardcode hex values in components.
LAYOUT: Strictly follow the 'Bento Grid' layout for the dashboard. Do not create a generic list view.
EDITOR: When implementing Monaco Editor, apply the custom theme defined in 'monaco_theme' to ensure it blends with the light mode UI.
FEEDBACK: Use the specific status colors (error/warning/success) for all feedback indicators and badges.
ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all text meets APCA contrast standards. The primary blue on white is safe, but be careful with muted text.
TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, grid items) as per the system rules.
ROUTING: Ensure the layout handles the 'Code Review' page differently (full screen, no standard footer) compared to the Dashboard (standard layout).
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': Do not use generic gradients or centered layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
